title: HEARTS: A Holistic Framework for Explainable, Sustainable and Robust Text Stereotype Detection
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype detection in religious contexts, specifically by evaluating whether LLM-generated text continuations from neutral religious prompts are stereotypical.
findings: Across 12 tested LLMs, religion-related prompts elicited stereotypical responses in approximately 55% of cases on average, a higher rate than for gender, race, and LGBTQ+ stereotypes. There was significant variation among models; for instance, LLaMA-3-70B-T exhibited a high propensity for religious stereotypes, while models like Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Gemini-1.5-Pro showed a lower propensity compared to the category average.
